changelog:
- Plugin 0.15.0: company card, skins and the Styles variables field, image hints, audit fixes
- Docs: skins and the Styles tab (DEVELOPER.md); CI checks the generated variable list is up to date
- Audit fixes: titles from WordPress printed as safe text (a stray tag could swallow the page); admin fields linked to their labels (a11y)
- Admin: image requirement hints (featured image with live width warning, company picture, author photo)
- Frontend: header logo served at displayed size (260/400 w srcset); author Gravatar photo downloaded and resized at build
- Styles tab: one pre-filled CSS field with every variable and its default (brand colours included), only changed lines are stored; brand colours follow into the lighter shades
- Styles tab: skin variables as one highlighted CSS field (WordPress CodeMirror) instead of a field per variable; custom CSS uses the same editor
- Styles tab: generated Design variables list (search, groups, reset, paste CSS, copy as CSS/JSON); server-side per-type validation; token registry generated from tokens.css + tokens.meta.json
- Skins: neutral defaults in the lowest CSS layer, skin tokens (theme.json + WordPress), skin variables for headings, links, buttons, boxes and hero; Blyss keeps today's look, Dayo gets its own skin
- Company card: standalone block with per-part switches (site-wide in Content, per article in the edit screen), editable title, picture and description; reviews fields no longer hidden
